figurative_meaning_en: Horoscope or astrological chart at the time of birth
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জন্মকুণ্ডলীতে শুভ গ্রহের অবস্থান দেখা গেছে।
বিয়ের আগে জন্মকুণ্ডলী মিলিয়ে দেখা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His birth chart shows favorable planetary positions.
The horoscopes were matched before the marriage.
history: This term originates from Vedic astrology traditions in Indian subcontinent, used for predicting life events based on planetary positions at birth.
note: Commonly used in Bengali Hindu culture for compatibility checks in marriages.
